description: Tide prediction points per surf spot: a NOAA CO-OPS station for the US spots (primary) and the EOT20 global tide model cell nearest the break (primary elsewhere, fallback for US spots). distance_km is the great-circle distance from the spot's break position (spots.json latitude/longitude). Model cells and their constants come from data/tides/constants_eot20.json (scripts/extract_tide_constants.py). Loaded by `python -m app.cli tides seed` and by the daily tides.acquire job. See docs/tides.md.

stations.name: Pillar Point Harbor, Half Moon Bay

stations.justification: Nearest CO-OPS prediction station, on the same North Shore coast (Waialua Bay, Haleiwa), 9.4 km SW of the break. Subordinate station (time and height offsets applied to Honolulu 1612340): CO-OPS publishes only its high and low waters, so the curve between them is interpolated here.
EOT20 global tide model cell 8.7 km from the break; used only when no CO-OPS predictions are stored for the window (never mixed into a station curve).

EOT20 global tide model cell 9.0 km from the break; used only when no CO-OPS predictions are stored for the window (never mixed into a station curve).

Nearest CO-OPS prediction station: Kahului Harbor on the same north shore of Maui, 18.6 km W of Peahi. Harmonic station (its own predictions at any interval).
EOT20 global tide model cell 8.1 km from the break; used only when no CO-OPS predictions are stored for the window (never mixed into a station curve).
Pillar Point Harbor, inside the point 2.0 km from the reef. Harmonic station (its own predictions at any interval).
EOT20 global tide model cell 11.0 km from the break; used only when no CO-OPS predictions are stored for the window (never mixed into a station curve).

Ocean Beach (outer coast), 1.7 km from the break on the same beach. Subordinate station (offsets applied to San Francisco, Golden Gate 9414290): high and low waters only, the curve between them is interpolated here. The harmonic Golden Gate station (6.6 km) is not used: it lies inside the strait, where the tide lags the open coast.
EOT20 global tide model cell 10.0 km from the break; used only when no CO-OPS predictions are stored for the window (never mixed into a station curve).

San Clemente, 4.6 km NW of Trestles on the same open coast. Subordinate station (offsets applied to San Diego 9410170): high and low waters only, the curve between them is interpolated here. The nearest harmonic station (Newport Bay Entrance 9410580) is 36.7 km away.
EOT20 global tide model cell 3.5 km from the break; used only when no CO-OPS predictions are stored for the window (never mixed into a station curve).
Rincon Island (an artificial island off Mussel Shoals), 4.3 km SE of the point on the same open coast. Harmonic station (its own predictions at any interval).
EOT20 global tide model cell 2.1 km from the break; used only when no CO-OPS predictions are stored for the window (never mixed into a station curve).
